title: Sessions
tagline: Book 1:1 sessions with anyone from anywhere for anything - ride the megatrend of the great wave of digital globalization
how_its_made: The protocol will be based on Lens protocol for profiles. The frontend will use React. Our smart contract will be deployed on Polygon and other EVM networks. All the payments are processed on-chain and your availability will be stored on the smart contract. The marketplace (a future feature) will be using the graph protocol for decentralized data indexing.
